question: Tell me top10 teams with the most wins across the league
sql:
WITH home_wins AS (
    SELECT home_team AS team_name
    FROM match_view
    WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal
),
away_wins AS (
    SELECT away_team AS team_name
    FROM match_view
    WHERE away_team_goal > home_team_goal
),
combined_wins AS (
    SELECT team_name, 1 AS win FROM home_wins
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team_name, 1 AS win FROM away_wins
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT team_name, COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM combined_wins
    GROUP BY team_name
    ORDER BY total_wins DESC, team_name ASC
)
SELECT team_name, total_wins
FROM team_wins
LIMIT 10
